title: Optimistic Verifiable Claims (OVC): Reproducibility Package
description: Smart contracts, measurement runners, archived transaction receipts and table/figure generation code for the paper "Optimistic Verifiable Claims: A Blockchain Protocol for Conditionally Confidential Bidding in Decentralized Manufacturing" (preprint arXiv:2607.25517). Version 5.0.0 replaces the OVC-Conformance predicate with a machine-profile check (line grammar, command list, travel envelope with exact arcs, extrusion height and material temperature window, decision D7), validates it on 60 G-code files of the OpenGCode MultiSlicer Corpus v1.0.0, and re-measures the conformance dispute locally and on the public testnets of Ethereum, Arbitrum and MegaETH. Every other contract and receipt is that of version 4.0.0. Versions 1.0.0-3.0.0 belong to the first version of the paper.
